fixed.optimizer: Seeded basin annealing with jitter or reflections of groups selected by measured graph times or fitted XYZ proximity. Sixty-four proposals per start, 400 local relaxation steps per proposal, decreasing Metropolis temperature and one fresh seeded 3D restart. Keep the best fit visible; no airport geography or sphere forces.
fixed.additional: Faster degree-normalized descent with error-decreasing backtracking, cached edge degrees and loss, and bounded animation work.

remaining.evidence: 82 of 34,782 fully observed triangles violate the triangle inequality by more than 0.001h. No arrangement of Euclidean points can satisfy such a triangle exactly.
remaining.interpretation: Travel times include route-dependent wind, performance, routing and schedule overhead. The exact cause of each remaining inconsistency has not been measured.
Short-flight residuals remain proportionately larger. There is no new cutoff or uniform time subtraction.

remaining.evidence: Five return observations recovered using exact dated independent evidence. 10,420 original observations remain quarantined, including ten confirmed stopped journeys. Exclusion means insufficient or conflicting evidence, not necessarily a connecting flight.
remaining.interpretation: The independent crowdsourced index can be stale. Unknown records are not assumed nonstop.

remaining.evidence: Raw source reports departure 13:40 and duration 10h40; the currently published independent dated schedule reports departure 13:25 and duration 10h55. The two matching October 3 and 7 return records are restored.
remaining.interpretation: The conflicting source observation is not guessed into the dataset.

remaining.evidence: All three tested starts reach 4.57–4.59% error with two annealing chains, versus 6.24–6.50% without annealing. Other seeds, datasets and sparse airports can still have worse or ambiguous fits.
remaining.interpretation: A settled fit means the bounded search ended and local movement is negligible. It does not certify a global minimum or a sphere.

errorDefinition: sqrt(sum((fittedHours-targetHours)^2)/sum(targetHours^2)). Airport scores use every incident edge. Positive residual means fitted separation is greater than the time target. Total edges count distinct neighboring airports.
